type Heap = Leaf | Node Heap int Heap
let insert x t =
  match t
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (insert x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (insert x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let tree = [37, 55, 6, 22, 35, 29, 31] |> List.fold (flip insert) Leaf
let toListT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListT l) (List.concat [v] (toListT rt))
print (toListT tree)
let minOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minOf l
print (minOf tree)
let containsT x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsT x l else containsT x rt
print (List.map (fun k -> containsT k tree) [37, 32, 20])

    case Add a b: Add (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case Mul a b: Mul (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case _: e

let readPair line =
  result {
    let! (k, v) =
      match String.split "=" line:
        case [k, v]: Ok (String.strip k, String.strip v)

    let! n = Option.toResult f"not a number: {v}" (String.toInt v)
    let! checked = if n < 0 then Error "negative" else Ok n
    return (k, checked)
  }

type Heap = Leaf | Node Heap int Heap
let insert x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (insert x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (insert x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let tree = List.fold (fun acc x -> insert x acc) Leaf [40, 8, 52, 42, 50, 29, 47]
let minT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minT l
print (minT tree)
let depthT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l _ rt: 1 + max (depthT l) (depthT rt)
print (depthT tree)
let containsT x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsT x l else containsT x rt
print (List.map (fun k -> containsT k tree) [40, 48, 44])
let toListOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListOf l) (List.concat [v] (toListOf rt))
print (toListOf tree)

  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf

    case Num n: n
    case Add a b: evalE a + evalE b

    case Neg a: -(evalE a)

  match e:
    case Num n if n < 0: f"({n})"
    case Num n: f"{n}"

    case Mul a b: f"{pretty a} * {pretty b}"

    case Add (Num 0) x | Add x (Num 0): simplify x
    case Mul (Num 1) x | Mul x (Num 1): simplify x
    case Neg (Neg x): simplify x
    case Add a b: Add (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case Mul a b: Mul (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case _: e

let add x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (add x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (add x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t

    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumOf l + v + sumOf rt

  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListOf l) (List.concat [v] (toListOf rt)

  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minOf l

  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsT x l else containsT x rt

    case Add a b: Add (shrink a) (shrink b)
    case Mul a b: Mul (shrink a) (shrink b)

let parseEntry line =
  result {
    let! (k, v) =
      match String.split "=" line:
        case [k, v]: Ok (String.strip k, String.strip v)
        case _: Error f"malformed: {line}"
    let! n = Option.toResult f"not a number: {v}" (String.toInt v)
    let! checked = if n < 0 then Error "negative" else Ok n
    return (k, checked)
  }

type Expr = Num int | Add Expr Expr | Mul Expr Expr | Neg Expr
let calc e =
  match e:
    case Num n: n
    case Add a b: calc a + calc b
    case Mul a b: calc a * calc b
    case Neg a: -(calc a)
let show e =
  match e
    case Num n if n < 0: f"({n})"
    case Num n: f"{n}"
    case Add a b: f"({show a} + {show b})"
    case Mul a b: f"{show a} * {show b}"
    case Neg a: f"-{show a}"
let simplify e =
  match e:
    case Add (Num 0) x | Add x (Num 0): simplify x
    case Mul (Num 1) x | Mul x (Num 1): simplify x
    case Neg (Neg x): simplify x
    case Add a b: Add (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case Mul a b: Mul (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case _: e

type Bst = Leaf | Node Bst int Bst
let insert x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (insert x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (insert x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t

let toListT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListT l) (List.concat [v] (toListT rt))

let minT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minT l

let containsT x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsT x l else containsT x rt

type Heap = Leaf | Node Heap int Heap
let add x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (add x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (add x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let root List.fold (fun acc x -> add x acc) Leaf [8, 32, 45, 1, 47, 49, 59, 35]
let depthT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l _ rt: 1 + max (depthT l) (depthT rt)
print (depthT root)
let toListOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListOf l) (List.concat [v] (toListOf rt))
print (toListOf root)
let sumT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumT l + v + sumT rt

let log = ["eli", "bo", "cy", "fay", "eli", "fay", "eli"]
let bump m w =
  match Map.tryFind w m:
    case Some n: Map.add w (n + 1) m
    case None: Map.add w 1 m
let counts = List.fold bump Map.empty log
print (counts |> Map.toList |> List.sortBy (fun (k, v) -> (-v, k)))
print (counts |> Map.map (fun k v -> v * 10) |> Map.values |> List.sort)
print (counts |> Map.keys |> List.sort |> String.join ",")
